intended_object: The canonical feature map a ↦ Φ(a) = K(·, a) of the minimal Kolmogorov decomposition (the canonical RKHS realization) of a scalar positive-definite kernel K : α × α → 𝕜. It satisfies ⟪Φ a, Φ b⟫ = K a b and the vectors Φ a have dense span. This comes from the docstring and the module documentation (Berg–Christensen–Ressel, Ch. 3).
